Alger, 15 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 15, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications has reached an agreement in principle with the Roblox platform to train local video game designers. This understanding follows the restoration of access to the platform nationwide.
Un programme de formation et des exigenc: A training program and regulatory requirements
Le partenariat prévoit un cursus de qual: The partnership provides for a qualification curriculum intended for Algerian creators of gaming software. This mechanism is designed to facilitate their integration into the global market as independents or freelancers. Developers will be able to distribute their creations on Roblox. Actions to support digital content creation among young people are also included in the program.
Le ministère a fixé des critères stricts: The ministry has set strict criteria regarding compliance with national values and child protection. Roblox has implemented an age-estimation system to filter content. The company has also expanded parental control options, including access time management and financial spending monitoring. Support for the Arabic language and the Algerian dialect is part of the approved measures.
La fonction de messagerie instantanée de: The instant messaging feature remains inactive for all users in Algeria. Its reactivation is conditional upon the installation of advanced moderation technologies in the Arabic language.
Le ministre de la Poste et des Télécommu: The Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Sid Ali Zerrouki, emphasized that the protection of minors constitutes an absolute priority. Meanwhile, Mohamed El Sheikh, Roblox's General Manager for the Middle East, North Africa, and Turkey, praised constructive exchanges with the Algerian authorities.
Mise en place d'un cycle de formation po: Implementation of a training cycle for local developers and freelancers.
Rétablissement effectif de l'accès à la: Effective restoration of access to the gaming platform in Algeria.
Désactivation maintenue de la messagerie: Continued disabled status of instant messaging until further notice.
